In [[3962 BBY]], as the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] invaded the territory of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the two fought a '''battle''' in the [[Ambria system/Legends|Ambria system]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] had initiated an operation they referred to as [[Mandalorian Triumph]], a campaign to take control of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. One prong of the advance took the Mandalorian forces from their territory to the [[Vena system/Legends|Vena system]]. After [[Battle of the Vena system|taking Vena]], the Neo-Crusaders passed through the [[Japrael system/Legends|Japrael system]], where they had [[First battle of Onderon (Mandalorian Wars)|taken]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] earlier in the war,<ref name="Atlas" /> to absorb troops from that planet's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]],<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> and continued on to Ambria. Once the Mandalorians had taken the [[Star system/Legends|system]] during the battle, they [[Battle of the Zel system|took]] the [[Zel system]] and eventually conquered a number of other systems as they continued their march Coreward.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.<ref name="Atlas" />
